title: Standard Refund Policy
content: Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5-7 business days. UPI and wallet refunds typically reach the customer in 1-3 business days, while credit and debit card refunds can take up to 7 business days depending on the bank. Cash on delivery orders are refunded to the customer's bank account or to the store wallet, whichever the customer chooses. Return requests are reviewed within 48 hours of the returned item being received at our warehouse. Shipping fees are refunded only if the return was caused by our error.

title: Return Policy for Non-Medicine Products
content: Wellness devices, supplements, personal care and other non-medicine products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused, unopened and in its original packaging with all tags and accessories. Opened supplements, personal care items and consumables cannot be returned for hygiene reasons unless they arrived damaged or incorrect. Return pickup is arranged free of cost for eligible returns, and the refund follows the Standard Refund Policy.

title: Medicine Return Policy
content: Medicines cannot be returned once delivered, except when the wrong medicine was sent, the package arrived damaged or tampered with, or the medicine is expired or near expiry. Such issues must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos of the product, batch number and outer packaging. After verification, we either send the correct medicine free of cost or issue a full refund, as the customer prefers. Medicines kept for more than 48 hours without a report are not eligible for return.

title: Order Cancellation and Address Changes
content: Orders can be cancelled free of charge any time before they are dispatched, from the Orders section of the app or by contacting support. Once an order has been dispatched it cannot be cancelled, but the customer may refuse delivery and the refund will be issued after the package returns to us. Orders awaiting prescription verification can be cancelled at any time before verification is completed. Any coupon used is restored if the order is cancelled before dispatch. The delivery address can be edited until the order is packed; after that, the customer should cancel before dispatch and place a fresh order.

title: Standard Delivery Terms
content: Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days in metro cities and 4-7 business days in other serviceable locations. Delivery is free on orders of Rs 499 and above, and a delivery fee of Rs 49 applies to smaller orders. Delivery is attempted up to three times, after which the order is returned to us and refunded. A reachable phone number is required for the delivery partner, and an OTP is shared at delivery to confirm the handover.

title: Express Same-Day Delivery
content: Express same-day delivery is available in select cities for orders placed before 2 PM, with an additional fee of Rs 99. Orders placed after 2 PM are delivered the next day. Express delivery is not available for items that need prescription verification beyond the cut-off time. If an express order is delayed beyond the promised slot, the express fee is refunded.

title: Delayed or Missing Delivery
content: If an order is delayed by more than 3 days beyond the estimated delivery date, the customer may cancel it for a full refund. Delays of more than 5 days also earn Rs 50 of store wallet credit. If tracking shows delivered but the customer has not received the package, it must be reported within 24 hours and we investigate with the delivery partner within 48 hours. Confirmed lost shipments are reshipped at no cost or fully refunded, as the customer prefers.

title: Prescription Verification Rules
content: Schedule H and H1 medicines require a valid prescription. A valid prescription must show the doctor's name and registration number, the patient's name, the date of issue, and the medicine names with dosage. Prescriptions for long-term medicines are accepted if not older than 6 months; for all other medicines the prescription must be issued within the last 30 days. Uploaded prescriptions are reviewed by a licensed pharmacist within 4 business hours, the customer may be called to confirm details, and the order is dispatched only after verification.

title: Rejected Prescriptions
content: A prescription may be rejected if it is blurry or cropped, is missing the doctor's registration number, is out of date, does not match the patient's name, or lists a medicine that cannot be sold online. The customer is notified in the app and by SMS with the reason. A corrected prescription can be re-uploaded against the same order within 24 hours; otherwise the order is cancelled and any prepaid amount is refunded in 5-7 business days. Customers without a valid prescription can book a teleconsultation to get one.

title: Controlled and Restricted Medicines
content: Schedule X and narcotic medicines are not sold on the platform under any circumstances. Schedule H1 medicines, such as certain antibiotics and sedatives, need a valid prescription and the pharmacist records each sale as required by law. Quantities are limited to what the prescription states, and refills beyond the prescribed quantity are not allowed.

title: Teleconsultation Policy
content: Teleconsultations with registered doctors last up to 15 minutes. A follow-up with the same doctor within 7 days of the first consultation is free. Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled up to 2 hours before the slot at no charge. When clinically appropriate, a prescription is shared within 30 minutes of the consultation ending. Doctors do not treat medical emergencies; in an emergency, the customer should visit the nearest hospital.

title: Consultation Refund Policy
content: A consultation is refunded in full if the doctor does not join within 30 minutes of the slot, if the call fails because of a technical issue on our side, or if the customer cancels at least 2 hours before the appointment. Consultation fees are not refunded when the customer is a no-show or when the consultation was completed. Refunds follow the Standard Refund Policy timelines.

title: Accepted Payment Methods
content: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, popular wallets and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available for orders up to Rs 5,000 and is not available with express delivery. Card details are handled by PCI-compliant payment partners and are never stored by us. EMI on cards is available for orders above Rs 3,000.

title: Failed Payments and Double Charges
content: If money is deducted but the order is not confirmed, the amount is automatically reversed within 5-7 business days. Duplicate charges are refunded automatically within the same period. If the reversal has not arrived after 7 business days, the customer should share the transaction ID and a bank statement screenshot so the team can raise it with the payment partner, which typically resolves it within 3 business days.

title: Coupons and Offers
content: Only one coupon can be applied per order, and coupons cannot be combined with other discount offers unless stated. Each coupon has a minimum order value and an expiry date shown in its terms. Coupons do not apply to prescription medicines unless specifically mentioned. If an order is cancelled before dispatch the coupon is restored; coupons are not restored after dispatch or for completed returns.

title: Account Access and Security
content: Passwords can be reset using an OTP sent to the registered mobile number or email. After 5 failed login attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. Customers who no longer have access to their registered mobile number can verify their identity with a recent order ID and email to update it. We never ask for OTPs, card PINs or passwords over call or chat.

title: Data Privacy and Deletion
content: Health records, prescriptions and order history are encrypted and shared only with the licensed pharmacists and doctors involved in the customer's care. Customers can request a copy of their data or ask for account deletion from the app settings or through support. Deletion requests are completed within 30 days, except for records we are legally required to retain, such as prescription sale records. Customer data is not sold to third parties.

title: Product Authenticity and Storage
content: All products are sourced directly from licensed manufacturers and authorised distributors. Temperature-sensitive medicines such as insulin ship in cold-chain packaging and must be placed in a refrigerator on receipt. Customers who suspect a product is counterfeit or tampered with should stop using it, keep the packaging, and report it within 48 hours with photos and the batch number for investigation and a full refund.

title: Expiry and Shelf Life Policy
content: Medicines are delivered with at least 3 months of remaining shelf life, and supplements with at least 6 months, unless the product page states otherwise. If a product arrives with a shorter shelf life, the customer can request a replacement or a refund within 48 hours of delivery. Expiry is counted to the last day of the month printed on the pack.

title: Adverse Reaction Reporting
content: Customers who experience an allergic reaction or side effect after taking a medicine should stop using it and consult a doctor immediately; in a severe reaction they should seek emergency care. The reaction can be reported to support within 24 hours with the medicine name and batch number, and the case is forwarded to our pharmacovigilance team. Support agents cannot give medical advice, and medicines that have been consumed are not returned; the report is used for safety follow-up.

title: Support Response Times and Escalation
content: First response times are 4 hours on chat and phone during working hours (8 AM to 10 PM) and 24 hours on email. Complex cases are resolved within 3 business days. If a ticket is unresolved after 3 business days, the customer can ask for escalation to a senior agent, and after a further 48 hours to the Grievance Officer, whose details are on the Contact Us page.
